attacks.name: Magical Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage and heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

name: Victini
flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

attacks.name: Energy Assist
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Victory Ball
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

name: Manaphy
flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

attacks.name: Marine Guidance
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Water Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Aqua Ring
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Keldeo
flavorText: When it is resolute, it body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

attacks.name: Sacred Sword
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Sacred Sword during your next turn.

abilities.name: Justified
abilities.text: This Pokémon's attacks do 50 more damage to your opponent's Darkness Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Mew
flavorText: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

attacks.name: Clairvoyance
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals his or her hand.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Meloetta
flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

attacks.name: Soprano Wave
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Entrancing Melody
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Darkrai
flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during the nights of the new moon.

attacks.name: Abyssal Sleep
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. Your opponent flips 2 coins instead of 1 between turns. If either of them is tails, the Pokémon is still Asleep.

name: Jirachi
flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

attacks.name: Precognitive Dream
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards. This Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Iron Head
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

name: Genesect
flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

attacks.name: Linear Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Destructor Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Arceus
flavorText: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

attacks.name: Type Switch
attacks.text: Choose Grass, Fire, Water, Lightning, Psychic, Fighting, Darkness, Metal, Fairy, or Dragon type. Until the end of your next turn, this Pokémon is that type.

attacks.name: Power Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
